items.snippet: At the end of the first quarter of 2026, the dollar amount of backlog believed to be firm was approximately $62.7 billion, about $11.5 billion higher than the fourth quarter of 2025.

items.title: cat-20251231
items.snippet: In 2026, dealer rental fleet loading and dealer's rental revenue are both projected to increase, compared to 2025. After reaching record levels in 2025, Oil & Gas is expected to see moderate growth in 2026.
